name: Gul'dan's Gift raises Skull of Gul'dan's effectiveness and cooldown (#3417)
contract: Gul'dan's Gift 804609 adds 49% (resolved 50% via the DieSides==1 +1 rule) to every effect of Skull of Gul'dan (800225, base 24% resolved 25% via the same rule) via SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, giving 25*1.5=37 (int truncation), and adds a flat 29999 ms (resolved 30000 ms) to its 90000 ms cooldown via SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, giving 120000 ms.
